description.narrative: Sunshine Healthcare Lanka Limited (SHL or the Company) is an integrated pharmaceutical player with operations across the value chain including (i) Pharma and Medical Devices import and distribution; (ii) Pharma Manufacturing; (iii) Pharma Retail (Pharmacies); and (iv) Distribution. The proposed IFC investment is an equity investment of up to LKR 3,270 million in SHL to support the Company in its growth plan to increase its pharma manufacturing capacity, augment its medical devices import segment, and expand its pharma retail footprint over the next three years (the Project).

The Project is expected to lead to an increase in access to health products in Sri Lanka through increased local production of respiratory health products, placement of diagnostic analyzer in hospitals for early detection and prevention of disease, automation of central logistics infrastructure, and expansion of retail footprint. IFC anticipates that financing the only pharmaceutical producer of metered dose inhalers (MDI) in Sri Lanka will support greater market resilience as spillover effects accrue to the pharmaceutical supply chain and potential local pharmaceutical manufacturers in this market, facilitating import substitution in the largely import-dependent market. The Project is also expected to contribute to the resilience of the pharmaceutical manufacturing market in Sri Lanka. The Project will promote greater stability of the MDI supply chains in Sri Lanka by improving the operational efficiency of the only local producer of MDI, reducing the reliance of the public sector on importation.
